WITH funding_ratios AS (
  SELECT
    p.fundflux,
    AVG((ss.boxy - ss.boxx) / NULLIF(ss.boxx, 0)) AS avg_y_vs_x_difference,
    SUM(ss.aream2) / NULLIF(SUM(ss.volm3), 0) AS area_volume_ratio
  FROM scanspatial AS ss
  JOIN projects AS p
    ON ss.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
average_ratio AS (
  SELECT AVG(area_volume_ratio) AS simple_avg_ratio
  FROM funding_ratios
)
SELECT
  fr.fundflux,
  fr.avg_y_vs_x_difference,
  fr.area_volume_ratio,
  fr.area_volume_ratio - ar.simple_avg_ratio AS above_average_by
FROM funding_ratios AS fr
CROSS JOIN average_ratio AS ar
WHERE fr.area_volume_ratio > ar.simple_avg_ratio;
